dialogues.speaker: Hannu
dialogues.text: P—Papers! G—Get your fresh newspapers here, sirs and ma'ams...!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What, ho! What news today, young man?

dialogues.speaker: Hannu
dialogues.text: W—Well... a treasure hunter pretended to be a Fatui officer, and put out an arrest warrant for himself in The Flagship. B—But the Fatui discovered the fake, and now they've issued a real one for him instead...

dialogues.speaker: Hannu
dialogues.text: I, u—umm... I need to take a look first. P—Please wait a moment...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Oh, no, it's okay. I'm fine without any papers to read.
